title: Supply Chain Attack on posthog-node
technical_mechanism: setup_bun.js stole npm/PyPI/Maven/GitHub tokens; auto-republished trojanized versions (Shai-Hulud v2)
summary: A malicious package 'posthog-node' was discovered in the npm ecosystem. The attack involved second-wave worm + cross-registry spread. Mechanism: setup_bun.js stole npm/PyPI/Maven/GitHub tokens; auto-republished trojanized versions (Shai-Hulud v2)
